description: Submit an unpaid booking for a bookings_live school (same path as the website Book now flow). The school still confirms availability; Extralingo emails the student; down payment is due within 5 days of school confirmation via Extralingo only. Never tell the user they are confirmed or paid. Requires OAuth bookings scope (Bearer token). Optional idempotency_key replays the same payload within 24 hours.

configuration.description: Same shape as the Extralingo school-page configurator: startDate (YYYY-MM-DD), students[] with courseId, weeks, optional accommodationGroupId, mealType, extras.

mealType.description: Meal plan key when accommodation is selected.

startDate.description: Course start calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). Typically a Monday from list_starting_dates.

students.description: One object per traveller. courseId comes from list_courses.

courseId.description: Course product id from list_courses for this school.

contact.description: Optional first_name, last_name, phone. Email always comes from the verified account; contact.email must match or be omitted.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for prices in this call. Usually EUR.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Same key + same payload within 24 hours replays the original response; conflicting payload returns validation_failed.

phoneCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country for the phone (e.g. NL).

privacyAccepted.description: Must be true when not using OAuth.

school_id.description: Craft CMS school entry id from search_language_schools hits (field school_id). Not the CRM UUID.

studentDetails.description: Per-student details aligned with configuration.students (names, dates of birth, etc.).

termsAccepted.description: Must be true when not using OAuth (OAuth grants record acceptance).

trip_id.description: Optional trip_id from save_trip linking this booking to a draft.

name: create_booking

bookingId.description: Craft booking id when returned by the booking engine.
